en: The image depicts a harbor scene with several small fishing boats docked in the water. In the background, there is a row of distinctive multi-story buildings with glass-enclosed balconies, typical of the Galician architectural style. The sky is clear, and the overall scene gives a vibrant and picturesque view of a coastal city. There is text in the upper left corner that reads 'LA CORUÑA', and a small watermark at the bottom left reads 'Biblioteca de Galicia'.
